digest.component_or_area: CLI command routing and schema registry
propositions: The obsolete file-backed bridge-status implementation and its dangling epic citation must remain absent from the codebase.
purge-bridge must be fully retired: absent from CLI help, implementation, active docs, and command routing.
Hidden bridge-status compatibility alias must route only through canonical durable bridge status and remain excluded from top-level help.
Schema registry must remove BRIDGE_STATUS export, constant, and bridge_status output-schema entry along with bridge_status.schema.json.
Both live bridge-status warnings in reads_cli.py must provide neutral bridge-alert guidance without referencing retired or unreleased commands.
Shipped-package tree and active command docs must contain zero matches for bridge-status or purge-bridge outside of test/archive/changelog contexts.
